name: MAST-ML dilute-solute diffusion educational slice
description: DFT dilute-solute diffusion barriers in host crystals, packaged with host/solute elemental descriptors for teaching.
count_scope: Educational Figshare v5 CSV, excluding header; independently parsed408 rows.

sources.title: MAST-ML educational release metadata
sources.evidence: v5 package declares MIT licensing and identifies the diffusion CSV as DFT-based.

sources.title: Educational dataset README
sources.evidence: Defines normalization relative to host self diffusion and a separate raw-energy target.

sources.title: Official diffusion educational CSV
sources.evidence: Independent parse gives408 non-header data rows; source SHA-256 retained in collection inventory.

caveats: Educational packaging derived from a prior diffusion corpus; do not add it to the parent as unique new materials.
Host/solute identities and descriptors are provided; periodic coordinates are absent.
Normalized and raw activation energies are different targets.

name: MAST-ML perovskite stability educational slice
description: Perovskite-oxide composition and crystallographic site identities paired with DFT stability/property labels and descriptors.
count_scope: Educational Figshare v5 CSV, excluding header; independently parsed1929 rows.

sources.title: MAST-ML educational release metadata
sources.evidence: v5 declares MIT licensing and identifies the perovskite CSV as DFT stability data.

sources.title: Educational dataset README
sources.evidence: Defines energy-above-hull and formation-energy targets and site-based elemental descriptors.

sources.title: Official perovskite educational CSV
sources.evidence: Independent parse gives1929 non-header data rows; payload hash retained.

caveats: No complete periodic atomic coordinates are present.
Educational slice and source-study dataset may have different denominators; this is explicitly the packaged row count.
Computed convex-hull distance is a screening measure, not experimental proof of synthesis or finite-temperature stability.

name: REMI Fe-Co-Ni combinatorial library
description: Experimental composition-spread alloy library with aligned X-ray diffraction and magnetic measurements.
count_scope: Released REMI library files at nist-pages commit 596b04435fb577175264a70c4434f5539b809510

sources.title: REMI direct data list
sources.evidence: Identifies this library as composition-spread data for discovery/optimization benchmarking.

sources.title: Library data description
sources.evidence: Documents sample-wise correspondence of composition, diffraction and magnetic measurements.

sources.title: Official release files
sources.evidence: MATLAB arrays C(921,3), XRD(921,89), Coer(921,1), Kerr(921,1) align across921 samples.

caveats: Sample points are not unique fully solved atomic crystal structures; atomic coordinates are absent.
Combinatorial alloy phases can include mixtures or amorphous regions; the crystalline state is not uniform across the library.
Release-specific data license was not verified; a general NIST/software license is not silently assigned.
Shared source experiments may appear in later active-learning studies; benchmark versions must preserve their provenance.
